cause_quote: The introducing diff wired `actionLabel: t("sessionsView.openSession")` to `onAction: () => { ... params.context.navigate(...) }`, which the toast rendered as a button with no link destination.
user_saw: Middle-clicking Open session in a background-session completion toast did nothing.
summary: The fix renders Open session as a native link so users can open the completed session in a new tab while preserving normal left-click navigation and the Gateway ownership check.
reasoning: The feature diff introduced the completion toast with a callback that navigated in the current tab. I checked the toast renderer at that commit and confirmed it used a button with only a click handler. The later Solid migration retained the button, so native new-tab navigation was missing from the feature's first release.
